item.rsapg.advanced_pattern_grid.help: A Pattern Grid without a blank-pattern slot: blanks come from the storage network. With an Autocrafting Upgrade it gets blanks crafted and keeps one of each ready. Encodes a Fluid Substitution Pattern when the recipe qualifies, and leaves fuzzy mode off when it would change nothing.
gui.rsapg.status.no_network: Not connected to an active storage network.
gui.rsapg.status.no_blanks: No blank patterns in the network. Add some, or put an Autocrafting Upgrade in the upgrade panel to have them crafted.
gui.rsapg.status.no_blank_pattern: No blank patterns in the network, and no autocrafting pattern that makes them.
gui.rsapg.status.crafting_blank: Crafting a blank pattern. The pattern will be encoded when it arrives.
gui.rsapg.status.missing_resources: Out of materials: a blank pattern can't be crafted.
gui.rsapg.status.network_full: The network is full: the pattern in the output slot could not be swapped out.
gui.rsapg.status.plain_fallback: No Fluid Substitution Pattern and no 2 empty buckets in the network, so this was encoded as a plain pattern.
gui.rsapg.status.spare_missing_resources: Out of materials: can't craft a spare blank pattern.
gui.rsapg.status.spare_no_blank_pattern: The Autocrafting Upgrade needs an autocrafting pattern for blank patterns.
gui.rsapg.blanks.title: Blank patterns come from the network
gui.rsapg.tree.button.help: Encodes a pattern for every recipe in this tree the network can't craft yet and puts each into a fitting autocrafter. Shows the plan first.
gui.rsapg.tree.need_grid: Open the recipe tree from an Advanced Pattern Grid.
gui.rsapg.tree.title: Recipe tree: missing patterns
gui.rsapg.tree.summary: %s to encode, %s already on the network, %s with no place to go, %s repeats
gui.rsapg.tree.summary.done: %s encoded and placed, %s failed, %s already on the network, %s with no place to go
gui.rsapg.auto_place.on.help: Each new pattern goes where the recipe-tree dump would put it: crafting patterns into rsmbac or a free autocrafter; processing patterns into the right machine's autocrafter when the recipe came in through EMI's +. Otherwise into network storage.
gui.rsapg.auto_place.off.help: New patterns stay in the output slot, as on a normal Pattern Grid.
gui.rsapg.auto_place.kept: Pattern left in the output slot: %s, and the network wouldn't take it
gui.rsapg.auto_place.unknown_machine: no machine known for it (load the recipe with EMI's +)
gui.rsapg.auto_place.no_target: no fitting autocrafter with a free slot
